トッキとリヴは胴体に剣による一致した金色の傷跡があるリヴは右手の人差し指が欠けているザイオンは額に余分な目があるザイオンの翼は影でできているため、少し透けて見えるように描いてほしいトッキはスカート、リヴとザイオンはパンツ姿で描いていただけるとありがたい

Hello! I hope you are well!

I was shown your work by a friend and was wondering if you would be interested in doing one of my character?

His name is "Six" and is an Android that is powered by a magical artifact. 
He is tasked with hunting down rouge magic users using magic and technology, but also questions his own sentience.
He is kind and upbeat with a kind soul, but is also capable of becoming a stoic and brutal machine when needed.
He is always looking to open and explore, but also knows when something needs his attention.

Feel free to do anything you see fit! His iris's, jacket, shirt and pants lights can all be changed.
I trust your vision completely. Feel free to experiment!

I would like to use your work for S.N.S and stream activites, with any and all credit going towards you.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
